parts.text: A student compares the rates of temperature increase of two different coloured surfaces. The student uses two thermometers, one of which has a piece of white card attached to its bulb, and one of which has a piece of black card attached to its bulb. Both pieces of card are identical, except for the colour of their surfaces. The student clamps the thermometers so that the bulb of each thermometer is level with the filament of a lamp. The lamp is switched off. Figure 2.1 shows the apparatus. Figure 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The student: • adjusts the distance d 1 between the lamp and the white card so that the card is 1.0 cm from the lamp • adjusts the distance d 2 between the lamp and the black card.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Measure, on Figure 2.1, the distance d 2 in centimetres to the nearest millimetre. d 2 = .................................................... cm [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The student: • records, in Table 2.1, the temperature shown by each thermometer at time t = 0 • switches on the lamp, and at the same time starts a stopwatch • waits for 4.0 minutes • switches off the lamp • takes the reading on each thermometer. The readings shown by the thermometers at t = 4.0 min are shown in Figure 2.2. Figure 2.2 Record the readings in Table 2.1. parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Determine the temperature increase Δθ between t = 0 and t = 4.0 min for each card. temperature increase of white card Δθ W = .......................................................... °C temperature increase of black card Δθ B = .......................................................... °C [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate the rate of temperature increase of each card. Use the equation: rate of temperature increase = Δθ t . Give your answers to 2 significant figures. Include the unit in your answer. rate of temperature increase of white card = ........................................ unit ............... rate of temperature increase of black card = ........................................ unit ...............
